svg.text: Signalbox — Pi Zero W Soldering Diagram
4-CH MOSFET PWM BOARD — direct GPIO PWM (no I2C)
R in series blocks high-freq noise; C drains it to GND
• LED wiring: OUT+ → 100Ω resistor → LED anode; LED cathode → OUT− (MOSFET low-side sink)
• RC cap: electrolytic 10µF, + leg to signal wire, − leg to GND • PAM8403 BTL: no GND connection at speaker terminals
